fusions.name: Homing Torpedo
fusions.desc: Launches a finned torpedo that steers itself into the first enemy it meets, which deals 14 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scatter Darts
fusions.desc: A spring tube fires 5 darts that fan out in a spread, and each one deals 3 damage to the enemy it strikes.

fusions.name: Greased Coupling
fusions.desc: Vents a slick of oil over your joints that removes up to 3 control conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wind-Up Pike
fusions.desc: A clockwork pike swims at your side and strikes an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
